travelbook.millenaire.byzantines.village: An ancient sacred shrine preserved by the Byzantines, steeped in imperial history and holy traditions.
The stone tiers of a classical Roman theatre, witnessing to dramatic arts and past imperial grandeur.
An isolated watchtower built of birch wood to guard the remote borders of the Empire.
A village owned by a player who has earned the trust of the Byzantine people.
A majestic lighthouse guiding Byzantine merchant vessels and warning of perilous coastal reefs.
A secluded Byzantine monastic retreat where contemplative monks inscribe ancient codices in quiet prayer.
A secluded pastoral farm producing quality Byzantine wool for imperial textile workshops.
A highland sheep farm where flocks graze peacefully on rugged slopes under the shepherd's watch.
Led by a Centurio in a massive fortress, the military village produces fine armoury, weaponry, olive oil and wine.
A sturdy oak-timber watchtower standing vigil over busy Byzantine trade roads.
A pine-wood observation outpost established amidst the forested ridges of the Empire.
Led by a Metropolitan, the religious village is known for their church, agricultural products and fine clothes from wool and silk.
Led by a Baron, the trading village is built around a market sqaure and features fine wool and silk clothes and Malvasia wine.
A tall surveillance tower adapted to warm climates and southern coastal frontiers.
travelbook.millenaire.indian.village.adi: A traditional native Adivasi homestead living in harmony with the surrounding forest.
travelbook.millenaire.indian.village.agr: This prosperous village focuses on harvesting rice and spices and turning them into delicious spicy food.
Built to supply the nearby palace, this hamlet produces food for the court.
travelbook.millenaire.indian.village.con: A village owned by a player who has earned the trust of the Indian people.
A village owned by a player who has earned the trust of the Indian people - with walls!
travelbook.millenaire.indian.village.des: A fortified desert outpost offering shelter and trade to weary caravan merchants traversing the arid dunes.
travelbook.millenaire.indian.village.for: Clustered around the great Rajput fort, this little village supplies it with food, weapons, and endless quantities of sandstone.
This mighty fort and its adjacent hamlet was built to protect the nearby palace.
travelbook.millenaire.indian.village.ind: The crumbling remains of an Indian farmstead deserted during times of drought.
travelbook.millenaire.indian.village.lon: A sacred secluded shrine consecrated to the deities, perfumed by holy incense and floral offerings.
travelbook.millenaire.indian.village.pal: This village surrounds the Raja's sumptuous palace and exists mostly to serve his whims.
This village surrounds the Raja's sumptuous palace and exists mostly to serve his whims.
travelbook.millenaire.indian.village.rui: An ancient sandstone stronghold now fallen to ruin, bearing witness to forgotten sieges.
travelbook.millenaire.indian.village.san: A former merchant haven battered and swallowed by shifting desert sands.
travelbook.millenaire.inuits.village.art: This Inuit village focuses on producing special Inuit items and goods.
travelbook.millenaire.inuits.village.ban: A rugged shelter serving as hideout for tundra outlaws and raiders.
travelbook.millenaire.inuits.village.bis: A nomadic hunting encampment following the migration trails of great Arctic bison.
travelbook.millenaire.inuits.village.com: This large Inuit village focuses on all aspects of life and thrives at it.
travelbook.millenaire.inuits.village.far: An Inuit settlement gathering edible lichens, hardy roots, and subarctic berries during brief thaws.
travelbook.millenaire.inuits.village.hun: This Inuit village focuses on hunting, meat is strength.
This Inuit village is owned and run by a player who earned the trust of the Inuit people.
travelbook.millenaire.inuits.village.inu: A monumental stone landmark guiding voyagers through the endless expanse of frozen tundra.
travelbook.millenaire.inuits.village.lak: An outpost of fishermen and seal hunters stationed on the shores of a frozen lake.
travelbook.millenaire.inuits.village.lon: A traditional subterranean ceremonial house devoted to the spirits of ice and ocean.
The sacred sanctuary of an angakkuq shaman communing with the spirits of blizzard and storm.
The lonely workshop of a craftsman sculpting ivory, bone tools, and walrus tusk amulets.
A dome of packed snow left deserted, slowly weathered away by arctic gales.
A large family snow shelter abandoned in the wake of a bitter winter.
The weathered timbers of a trapper's log cabin abandoned seasons ago.
A sizable boreal timber lodge yielding under the weight of accumulated snows.
A hardy fisherman cutting holes through pack ice to catch fish and seal.
A sturdy snowblock igloo sheltering an Inuit hunter and his kin from the freeze.
A grand snowdome built to accommodate multiple hunters and their blubber stores.
A rugged timber cabin where a lonely trapper dries pelts and cures caribou meat.
A frontier log house hosting dogsled teams and trappers at the taiga fringe.
A vital craftsman shaping sleds, kayak frames, and tools from precious driftwood.
travelbook.millenaire.inuits.village.pol: A cavern of ice and bones, domain of the great white bear of the north.
travelbook.millenaire.inuits.village.rel: This Inuit village focuses on their spiritual needs.
travelbook.millenaire.inuits.village.san: A coastal seasonal settlement harvesting ocean fish, seals, and kelp.
travelbook.millenaire.japanese.village.b: A cavern high in the cliffs harbouring dishonoured outlaws and bandits.
A fortified palisade serving as a staging ground for rogue rōnin.
travelbook.millenaire.japanese.village.c: A prestigious Japanese domain governed under the direct authority of the player.
travelbook.millenaire.japanese.village.g: A martial village centered on a disciplined dōjō and garrisoned by formidable samurai.
travelbook.millenaire.japanese.village.h: A tranquil mountain inn famous for soothing geothermal hot springs and delicate culinary arts.
travelbook.millenaire.japanese.village.j: A fortified border outpost commanding mountain passes and strategic valleys.
travelbook.millenaire.japanese.village.k: A keyhole-shaped burial mound preserving the remains and sacred treasures of early rulers.
travelbook.millenaire.japanese.village.l: A monumental statue of the Buddha radiating serenity across the surrounding countryside.
A secluded mining operation extracting rich iron veins and stone from volcanic ridges.
travelbook.millenaire.japanese.village.n: Terraced, flooded paddies cultivated with great care to yield bountiful harvests of rice.
travelbook.millenaire.japanese.village.s: A tranquil sanctuary assembled around a Buddhist pagoda where sacred bells chime.
travelbook.millenaire.japanese.village.t: A bustling commercial market teeming with silk merchants, paper makers, and craftsmen.
travelbook.millenaire.japanese.village.w: A quiet Shinto shrine sheltered beneath ancient trees, approached through a vermilion torii.
travelbook.millenaire.mayan.village.agri: Based around a Sacred Ball Court, this Maya village is focused around agriculture and the production of unique Maya foods to feed the king.
travelbook.millenaire.mayan.village.cont: A village owned by a player who has earned the trust of the Maya people.
travelbook.millenaire.mayan.village.lone: A sacred freshwater sinkhole revered as an entrance to the shadowy underworld of Xibalba.
A secluded jungle milpa tending sacred maize according to ancestral Maya tradition.
A humble forest homestead cultivating tropical fruits and treasured cacao pods.
An ancient quarry from which monumental stone blocks for grand temples were hewn.
A stepped pyramidal monument reaching towards the sky, dedicated to solar observances.
The vine-choked stone foundations of a Maya home reclaimed by the humid rainforest.
The isolated dwelling of an Ah Waay shaman reading omens and brewing ritual herbal remedies.
travelbook.millenaire.mayan.village.maya: A fortified lair of renegade warriors ambushing trade parties beneath the rainforest canopy.
A hidden jungle camp occupied by outlaws and marauders.
The crumbling stone steps of a monumental pyramid forsaken to the jungle.
travelbook.millenaire.mayan.village.mili: Surrounding a mighty Pyramid, this Maya village is focused around warfare and the production of unique Maya weapons and armor for the defense against opposing villages.
travelbook.millenaire.mayan.village.reli: With a great Observatory at its center, this Maya village specializes in trade and the creation of items and decorations to appease the gods.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.aba: The rotting sails of an old Norman windmill standing silent against the wind.
A collapsed mineshaft where the ring of pickaxes has long since gone quiet.
A cracked stone watchtower whose garrison vanished decades ago.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.agr: A village where tasty food is produced under the vigilant eyes of the Seneschal for stockpiling in his fancy manor.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.art: Centered on a mighty Guild Hall, this village specialises in fancy buildings and proper craftsmanship.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.ban: A reinforced den sheltering highwaymen and outlaws preying on unwary travelers.
An old fortified tower occupied by well-armed bandits looking for plunder.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.bou: A somewhat self-sufficient village build around a fort.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.con: A village owned by a player who has earned the trust of the Norman people.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.ecc: Extending around an abbey, this village exists to serve the monks' material needs in exchange for salvation, in the next world if not in this one.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.fel: The imposing fortress of a treacherous lord in defiance against lawful authority.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.gro: The centre of a thriving network of hamlets, this village holds the more advanced buildings.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.ham: A small abbatial hamlet at the periphery of a Gros Bourg.
A small hamlet focused on growing food for the nearby Gros Bourg.
A small hamlet where villagers dig stone and produce construction goods to support the nearby Gros Bourg.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.lon: A peaceful Norman abbey where cloistered monks pray, brew cider, and produce aged cheese.
A welcoming roadside tavern offering hearty meals, fresh cider, and shelter to wayfarers.
The woodland cabin of a sturdy woodsman supplying timber to nearby Norman settlements.
A resilient lumberjack harvesting spruce logs amidst cold, snowy taiga forests.
An independent windmill grinding golden grain into fine flour for local bakers.
A solitary quarryman digging deep into rocky hills for quality iron and building stone.
A secure waystation along trade routes for changing horses and resting between journeys.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.mil: A village surrounding a military fort and providing the garrison with food and weapons.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.not: Centered on the massive Norman Cathedral, this village supports the Marvel's construction and hosts visiting pilgrims.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.pan: A monumental edifice raised to honour the legends, leaders, and architects of Normandy.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.rui: The crumbling stone walls of a once-thriving homestead swallowed by wild briars.
travelbook.millenaire.norman.village.wal: A village owned by a player who has earned the trust of the Norman people, with walls to keep intruders out.
travelbook.millenaire.seljuk.village.agr: A small Seljuk  village concentrating on agriculture.
A Seljuk  village concentrating on agriculture.
travelbook.millenaire.seljuk.village.art: A small village where villagers mine stone and produce decorational goods to sell them to other villages.
travelbook.millenaire.seljuk.village.ban: A tent encampment harboring nomadic raiders striking at caravan convoys.
A captured watchtower commanding panoramic views over the arid plains.
travelbook.millenaire.seljuk.village.ham: The fallen domes of an ancient bathhouse retaining traces of turquoise tilework.
travelbook.millenaire.seljuk.village.lon: A steppe ranch raising cattle and fine horses beneath expansive open skies.
A solitary farm producing grain, figs, and pistachios in the traditional Anatolian style.
A secluded trading post situated at desert trail crossings selling carpets and rare spices.
A stone quarry supplying sandstone and ores to grand Seljuk architectural projects.
travelbook.millenaire.seljuk.village.mil: A Seljuk village that focuses on security, therefore also on weapons and armor.
travelbook.millenaire.seljuk.village.rel: A Seljuk village that has a mosque in the center of the village.
travelbook.millenaire.seljuk.village.rui: Carved stone columns and arches commemorating the grandeur of forgotten eras.
A disused mineshaft with rotted timbers, long abandoned to the silence of the hills.
The crumbling remnants of a defensive curtain wall eroded by centuries of weathering.
An ancient masonry well whose waters ran dry under the blazing desert sun.
travelbook.millenaire.seljuk.village.tra: A Seljuk village concentrating on trading and producing.
